armed-conflicts.headline: UN aid truck driver killed in Sudan; Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions rise.
armed-conflicts.summary: Major armed conflicts persist globally with no significant de-escalation reported today. Tensions between Ethiopia and Eritrea escalated with Ethiopia closing its embassy and expelling diplomats. A UN truck driver was killed in an airstrike in South Kordofan, Sudan, highlighting ongoing dangers to humanitarian operations.

human-rights.headline: French police tactics against student protests draw criticism.
human-rights.summary: Concerns about human rights emerged from France where policing of high school protests against under-resourced schools led to severe injuries to students, including a 14-year-old with a shattered jaw. An officer was charged in relation to the injuries, bringing police tactics under scrutiny.

climate-events.headline: Kilauea active; South Sudan floods persist, East Africa faces drought.
climate-events.summary: Kilauea volcano in Hawaii continued to show activity with a Watch alert and Orange aviation code due to ongoing magma intrusion. Persistent inundation in the Sudd wetlands of South Sudan and significant rainfall deficits across Chad and large parts of Eastern Africa highlight ongoing climate-related hazards.
